top_signals.title: Japanese, Korean Stocks Tumble as Chip Selloff Intensifies
top_signals.summary: Japanese and South Korean stocks slid, led by semiconductor shares, as concerns over Nvidia Corp.’s blockbuster AI supply deal and intensifying competition from Chinese chipmakers weighed on investor sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Crypto stocks rally thanks to rotation from AI infrastructure; bitcoin miners lag
top_signals.summary: Crypto stocks proved some of the top gainers Monday even as the broader market sold off and  capital rotated away from chip and AI infrastructure names.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: CNBC Daily Open: Apple reclaims its crown, SpaceX returns to Earth
top_signals.summary: Nvidia has been dethroned by Apple, with the company reaching a market cap of $4.95 trillion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
